lifecycles._note: COVERAGE-ONLY (mutation-gated). STS (Security Token Service) issues short-lived credentials. Closes all 3 sts writes: POST /v1/assume-role (assumerole), POST /v1/assume-role-with-saml (assumerolewithsaml), POST /v1/object-store-authorization (objectstoreauthorization). CRITICAL HOST BUG (confirmed 2026-06-29): sts is treated as REGIONAL in core/config.py DEFAULT_GLOBAL_SERVICES (not listed there), routing calls to sts.kr-west1.e.samsungsdscloud.com — that host returns the Samsung Cloud Platform WEB PORTAL HTML 404 page (Content-Type: text/html), NOT a JSON API response. The correct host is sts.e.samsungsdscloud.com (GLOBAL, no region segment), which returns proper JSON API responses (Content-Type: application/json). FIX REQUIRED: add 'sts' to DEFAULT_GLOBAL_SERVICES in core/config.py (or set SCP_SERVICE_HOSTS={"sts":"https://sts.e.samsungsdscloud.com"}). This fragment's paths are CORRECT — /v1/assume-role, /v1/assume-role-with-saml, /v1/object-store-authorization confirmed in api_docs.json and doc_url. After fixing the host routing, the steps will reach the real API gateway but still return 4xx (assumerole: role trust policy mismatch 403; assumerolewithsaml: no SAML provider 400/404; objectstoreauthorization: no session_token in auth 400/401). 2xx requires: (1) a self-assumable IAM role created and trust policy configured, (2) a SAML provider for assumerolewithsaml, (3) a valid session_token from a prior assumerole 200 for objectstoreauthorization. SAFETY: this lifecycle deliberately does NOT capture or persist any returned token/credential (no capture/capture_soft on responses) so it never exfiltrates real creds. BODY SHAPES CONFIRMED from api_docs.json models (2026-06-20): assumerole uses role_indicator (NOT role_arn), format [offering:account_id:role_name] pattern ^[^:]+:[^:]+:[^:]+$ minLength 32; assumerolewithsaml uses role_indicator+principal_indicator+saml_assertion; objectstoreauthorization uses method+url+x_amz_content_sha256+x_amz_date (NOT bucket_name). role_session_name minLength 1, maxLength 64.

steps.name: assume-role
steps._note: assumerole: mints temporary creds for a role. FIELD: role_indicator (NOT role_arn) format [offering:account_id:role_name] pattern ^[^:]+:[^:]+:[^:]+$ minLength 32. Using real account_id ec11538abf8f46d2953539521f745366 and existing role OrganizationAccountAccessRole. Expected: 200 if this account can assume the role (trust policy allows), or 400/403/404 if not (role trust policy only allows Account 73eab1a74c6347c1be9c892efc7f1102 to assume, so 403/404 likely). role_session_name min 1 char max 64. No token captured (safety — session_token/access_key_id not captured).

steps.name: assume-role-with-saml
steps._note: assumerolewithsaml: federated SAML token mint. FIELDS: role_indicator (same format as assumerole), principal_indicator ([offering:account_id:principal_name] pattern ^[^:]+:[^:]+:[^:]+$ minLength 32), saml_assertion (base64 SAML doc, minLength 1). Using placeholder base64 value (NOT a real SAML assertion) and nonexistent principal_indicator so no usable credential can be issued. Expected: 400/422 (invalid/fake SAML assertion) or 404 (no SAML provider). Account has 0 SAML providers confirmed. No token captured (safety).

steps.name: object-store-authorization
steps._note: objectstoreauthorization: creates an S3-compatible Authorization header signature using the caller's session token. FIELDS: method (REQUIRED, HTTP verb), url (REQUIRED, full object-store URL), x_amz_content_sha256 (REQUIRED, SHA256 of request body — empty body SHA256 is the well-known constant), x_amz_date (REQUIRED, AMZ date format YYYYMMDDTHHmmssZ), region (optional default kr-west1), service (optional default s3). CRITICAL: this endpoint does NOT take bucket_name/duration_seconds (prior fragment was wrong). x_amz_content_sha256 uses the SHA256 of empty string (UNSIGNED-PAYLOAD alternative). Expected: 200 if valid session token in HMAC auth header (this account is using access_key not session_token, so likely 400/401/403). No Authorization header value captured (safety — would be a temporary credential).
